limitations: Rule-based demo: no AI model, probabilities, or validated diagnostic accuracy.
Eight generic code definitions; manufacturer-specific coverage is not included.
Vehicle details are context only; rules are not tailored to make/model/year.
No live vehicle measurements were analyzed. Free text requires human review.
No codes does not mean no fault. Mock scans contain simulated evidence.
safety_message: This is preliminary guidance, not a diagnosis or a determination that driving is safe. If overheating, oil-pressure warnings, braking/steering trouble, smoke, strong fuel smell, or a flashing check-engine light occurs, reach a safe stopping place and seek professional or roadside assistance. Follow your vehicle owner's manual.
